goal: Remember which lab tools a survivor has equipped and enforce the rules about them: a limited number of slots, no duplicates, and only tools whose lab module the player has unlocked.
acceptance_criteria: A ModuleScript at src/server/Loadout.luau returns a table with Equip, Unequip, Get and Clear functions, all annotated.
Equip returns both a boolean and a reason string, so a refused equip can tell the player why.
A full loadout, a duplicate tool and a tool the player has not unlocked are each refused with a distinct reason.
Get returns a copy, so a caller cannot edit a player's loadout without going through Equip.
Every file begins with --!strict and the whole project passes scripts/verify.ps1.
notes: Keep it small: one module, under 120 lines. A short answer is a correct answer more often.
Return only the files you create. Do not return a file you are not changing.
